design_note: prompt-representative design: each position reuses the realization of its prompt group's representative (first in manifest order); positions keep their preselected weights; uncertainty resamples tasks, so reuse within a task is counted together and the 30 positions are not 30 independent prompts
representative_seed_reuse_note: representative_seed_reuse: the position reuses its prompt group's representative seed and representative A0/A1 pair; it never denotes a mismatch between A0 and A1 or between the timed generation and the output a monitor will judge (both are the representative A0 call).

sensitivity_stage1_repeat1.label: SENSITIVITY, not the primary: stage-1 repeat index 1 of each position's representative pair, bounded at the stage-1 cap (None new tokens); capped calls are incomplete realizations

sensitivity_own_seed_repeat0.label: SENSITIVITY, not the primary: every position's OWN stage-1 repeat-0 pair (its own seed), bounded at the stage-1 cap (None new tokens); capped calls are incomplete realizations

supporting_stage1_pairs.label: SUPPORTING, not the primary: the curtailed stage-1 repeat-0 pairs (cap 4,096 tokens) of the representatives; elapsed times are not expected to be equal to the main stage's
